description.value: Big Bang Bagels is a beloved Fernie institution that has been hand-making fresh bagels every morning for over 10 years. Located on 2nd Avenue in the heart of town, it's known as the busiest café in Fernie, with lineups out the door during peak seasons. Touring cyclists will find a huge variety of hearty bagelwiches and breakfast bagels—perfect fuel for a day in the saddle through the Elk Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Big Bang Bagels is an active café/bakery at 502 2nd Avenue in Fernie, BC, with phone and email matching OSM. Takeout is confirmed via their online ordering system. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are explicitly mentioned on the menu page ('we have Gluten Free' and multiple vegetarian bagelwiches like the Avolauncher). No evidence was found on the website or in OSM tags regarding bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging facilities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, high-traffic café in Fernie with hearty food, takeout ordering, and dietary accommodations—an obvious refuelling stop for touring cyclists on the Kootenay routes.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Gluten-free bagels available (not baked in-store). Vegetarian options include Avolauncher (avocado, red onion, cream cheese, cheddar) and spinach & sprouts substitutions. Allergen notice lists nuts, eggs, milk, seeds, flour, fish on site

wow_evidence: hand-making fresh bagels every morning for over 10 years... known as the busiest café in Fernie
